status_legend.confirmed: Provider page was read and the free/paid finding is documented.
status_legend.ambiguous: Page was read but the free claim could not be confirmed; not counted as free.
status_legend.partial: Only a cookie banner or partial content was visible.
status_legend.unreachable: Provider page failed (HTTP 500); figures come from third parties.
status_legend.not_confirmed: Lead/paid extra only; no provider confirmation of free access.

link_sweep._comment: Mechanical HTTP status sweep from GitHub Actions run 40471064309 (workflow_dispatch on main, 2026-10-27). NOT content verification: a 200 does not prove a resource is free and a 403 is usually bot filtering. Research statuses in `urls` were changed only where the provider page was actually re-read.

non_2xx.finding: Bot filtering, not a dead link. Page re-read 2026-10-27 via a browser-like fetch: 'Free course' and 'Free statement of participation on completion' are still displayed. Claim holds.

notes: The other 27 URLs returned 200 to curl. This is inferred from the job summary's counts (200 x 27, 403 x 3) plus its complete non-2xx list; the raw link-status.tsv artifact could not be downloaded from this sandbox because its Azure Blob redirect is outside the egress allowlist.
A 200 does not resolve an ambiguous, partial or not_confirmed status. Coursera, Jobberman, LinkedIn and the paid extras were not re-read, so their research statuses are unchanged.

LinkedIn re-checked 2026-10-27 with a browser-like fetch: /learning/ returned 403 and the Recruiter help article returned 500. The sweep's 200 is a login wall, not readable content; both remain 'unreachable'.
